provenance.consumption: include_str! frozen scene.agscene + world.at + assets/<sha>.glb; the harness writes the project (scene + assets) under target and loads via Storage::load_project; variants feed scripts/<sha>.at where <sha> = scene.behavior.source.sha256
provenance.load_verification: the load path hash-verifies the behavior source and every assets/<sha>.glb against the scene manifest; GLB geometry admission runs in the driver preflight decoder before allocation
